threads.detail: They are celebrating eight years together and visiting Prague for the first time.
Nothing is booked; they want one nice dinner and slow wandering. They prefer breakfast after nine and no early tours; other plans and practical timings remain open.
Nora loves architecture and old staircases.
Ben likes jazz and little bookshops.
They both like fish, roast vegetables and lemon desserts. Nora usually drinks sparkling water; Ben sometimes has red wine. They prefer dinner that is not too drawn-out or formal.
They share a bed but prefer two duvets; Nora is usually warm and prefers a firm pillow, while Ben is usually cold and prefers a soft pillow. Ben reads before breakfast.
Nora has a cappuccino and does ten minutes of yoga; Ben drinks Earl Grey without milk. They like breakfast after nine and do not want early tours.
Nora loves dried apricots and Ben loves dark chocolate; they joked about having different stashes.
